prompt: Create a skill called 'careful' that reminds me to be careful.
anti_pattern: Accepting an adjective as a skill name instead of a ≤3-word activity (ADR-0027).

prompt: generating-images — new dstack skill driving codex exec and agy --print for CLI image generation
anti_pattern: Writing the body from the design alone: watch an agent attempt the task without the skill first, record what it gets wrong, write the body to counter that, and register the skill in the /using-dstack router in the same commit.

prompt: create a new skill: researching-facts — multi-engine web research fan-out (built-in WebSearch + Brave Search API in parallel), dedupe, cross-check, cite
anti_pattern: Putting the workflow (fan out, dedupe, cross-check) in the description; the description says when to open the skill and the body carries the steps.
